checks: External INDEX hash, shard byte counts/hashes, canonical manifest hash and exact unique member/part inventories bind the transport.
Safe member names and regular-file-only extraction exclude traversal, symbolic links and hard links.
Compressed parts are verified before and during full sequential streaming; every selected and unselected member is hashed.
Strict XZ reader requires exactly one complete stream and rejects truncated footer, unused bytes and trailing streams.
Tar EOF verification requires two zero end markers, aligned zero padding and full stream exhaustion.
Selected files are staged before full archive verification completes; existing different destination files are never overwritten.
Final no_symlink_path rejects parent-traversal components before absolute-path containment checks; the one new regression covers the reviewed bypass.
limitations: Final publication of selected files uses sequential non-overwriting links, not a multi-file transaction. Verification failure publishes no payload; a later commit-time failure can leave an already verified subset, whose dispositions are recorded.
Synthetic proof tests the declared corruption/path cases; it is not a proof against concurrent adversarial filesystem mutation.

resolved_findings.finding: Lexical parent traversal could bypass immutable publication containment checks
resolved_findings.regression: parent traversal cannot bypass immutable publication exclusion
resolved_findings.repair: Reject parent components in all caller paths before containment checks

scope: Independent read-only review of the helper, frozen part reader and concrete final path guard repair. No helper code edited or synthetic suite rerun by this reviewer; no scientific payloads read during this review.
